metadata.title: मणिपुर: क्या मोदी दोषियों को सज़ा दे पाएंगे? | Viral Video: Will Modi fix the accountability
metadata.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has promised that the culprits involved in a heinous crime against women in Manipur will not be spared. This the first time prime minister has spoken about the Manipur but even today he did not say anything on the continuing violence in the state. Will he fix accountability in Manipur?
